name: Regular I Boot Left
purpose: Boot Left off the toss action. Everybody sells the toss going right and the quarterback keeps it to the left edge alone — the tight end in the flat in front of him, the Z coming all the way across behind. Run first, throw second.

LTE.rule: Engage the end over you for a count, then release to the flat at four yards and stay in front of the quarterback. You are the easy throw.

LG.sell: PULL RIGHT and run the toss path to sell the fake. Take a linebacker with you.

Z.rule: Come all the way across the field behind the line and get to eight yards on the far side. You are the second look and you arrive late on purpose.

QB.rule: Fake the toss with both hands, hide the ball on your back hip, and get to the edge. Run it if it is open. Only throw if a defender comes up to take you.

FB.sell: Run the toss path away from the boot and block whatever shows. Sell it.

TB.rule: Run the full toss path away from the boot with your arms tucked like you have the ball. Sell it all the way to the sideline.

coaching_points: Our ends must engage their end before releasing — sell the run first, then get out.
Run first. At this age the quarterback usually walks into ten yards before anyone finds him.
No blitzing is allowed for 8- and 9-year-olds, so the quarterback has time. Teach him to be patient and look up.
One throw, then tuck it. No scrambling backwards, ever.
